scope: Local synthetic async admission validation; no vehicle or physical output

baseline.scope_note: Reproduced before modifying control_execution.rs; other v5 navigation work was concurrent in the shared working tree. The real navigator emitted a positive straight intent.

model_envelope.coordinates: Rectangle aligned with the original measured source body frame; source measurements and timestamps are not rewritten
model_envelope.speed_bound: V=max(normalized source measurement, all adopted speed targets since source, held target, projected speed, candidate target)
model_envelope.curvature_bound: K=max(abs(source applied curvature), abs(all adopted targets since source), abs(held/applied curvature), abs(candidate target))
model_envelope.distance_bound_m: S=V*T+V^2/(2*b), b=configured max_decel_mps2; complete original lease plus one control period and full braking retained
geometry_checks: whole rectangle corners against world bounds
whole rectangle corners against active oriented light boundary
laser disc vs source-body rectangle after lidar TF
visual cone disc vs source-body rectangle
model_envelope.margin: Configured clearance remains unchanged; a scale-dependent floating arithmetic allowance is added
model_envelope.work: Existing bounded history traversal gains two maxima; background certificate remains one obstacle pass plus constant geometry/model checks; no allocations in envelope checks; poll unchanged
unchanged_guards: normal speed window and lateral transition peak

assertions: all 23 real-controller reports adopted Drive with no rejection or fault
CommandExpired Stop then complete braking to 0
real_default_worker_clear.plant: Independent exact straight integral; acceleration/deceleration 0.6m/s^2 (acceleration deliberately faster than navigation 0.4m/s^2)

real_default_worker_blocked.result: real navigator intent speed 0, final Stop

direct_full_speed.cone_tests: body y=.29 rejects radius .14; body y=.32 accepts

independent_footprint_containment.notes: Geometry-only containment across the valid configuration domain, including combinations that separate dynamic admission gates may reject; not a claim that all these trajectories are issued by the controller. Uses independent midpoint integration, not project_motion.

history_and_stop.cases: All high targets retained from source730 to plan840 despite Stop800; source810 after Stop still retains applied curvature1.96 while commanded curvature is0

coverage: original body fits but stopping envelope violates oblique light line

limits: Static world obstacles only; moving obstacles are not certified.

Assumes source pose/speed and frame association are valid, adopted command history is correct, no slip/reversal or speed/curvature overshoot, and braking realizes at least the configured deceleration.
Geometric path-length bound does not depend on the acceleration rate, but projected navigation state and other dynamic checks still use the configured model.
The original control-period allowance still presumes independently scheduled polling; this is not a real-time scheduling guarantee.
Rectangle can remain conservative in tight turns; core navigation has its own unchanged body/collision/braking gates.
This is short synthetic default-worker validation, not a full asynchronous race or hardware acceptance.
